claims.claim: 速效救心丸（国药准字 Z12020025）由川芎与冰片的活性成分制成，每丸重 40 mg。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: SJP is composed of tetramethylpyrazine and borneol approval number Z12020025 of the China State Food and Drug Administration [SFDA]). The SJP and placebo pills are provided by Tianjin Zhongxin Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. (Tianjin, China). The placebo pills are similar to the SJP, with a comparable appearance. Each pill weighs 40 mg.
claims.applicability: 本品配方与规格，适用于所有含服场景的人群描述，与血压问题无直接人群限定。
claims.uncertainty: 批准文号与规格来自试验方案文献，官方说明书现行文本待核验。

claims.claim: 该随机、双盲、安慰剂对照、多中心试验（ChiCTR1800014258）纳入 324 例气滞血瘀型慢性稳定型心绞痛患者，在标准治疗基础上加用速效救心丸（5 丸、每日 3 次）24 周。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: This is a prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, and multicenter trial. The trial will enroll 324 participants with chronic stable angina (Qi Stagnation and Blood Stasis syndrome). All participants will have received the conventional therapy of chronic stable angina. Participants will be randomized into two groups, conventional therapy plus SJP group and conventional therapy plus placebo group. Eligible participants will receive either SJP or placebo (five pills administered orally, three times daily) in addition to conventional treatment for 24 weeks.
claims.applicability: 适应症内人群（气滞血瘀型稳定型心绞痛）加用本品的最高质量试验设计。
claims.uncertainty: 为方案而非结果；所引为试验设计，未纳入结果数据。

claims.claim: 该试验允许继续合用抗血小板药、ACEI/ARB、他汀、钙拮抗剂、β 受体阻滞剂与长效硝酸酯。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: Both the experimental group and control group can take antiplatelet drugs, angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor (ACEI) or angiotensin II receptor antagonist (ARB), statins, calcium ions antagonists, beta-blockers, and long-acting nitrates; the above drugs can continue to be used without changing the original dose
claims.applicability: 直接回答控制良好的高血压患者是否可在降压治疗基础上接受本品。
claims.uncertainty: 为试验的合并用药规定，非本品的药物相互作用结论。

claims.claim: 该试验排除收缩压≥180 mmHg 或舒张压≥100 mmHg 的未控制高血压。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: Uncontrolled hypertension with systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥ 180 mmHg or diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ≥ 100 mmHg, or severe arrhythmia
claims.applicability: 该排除阈值为试验入排标准，非本品的含服血压下限；不适用于未控制高血压的自行含服。
claims.uncertainty: 排除标准仅界定试验人群，不能外推为本品的使用禁忌。

claims.claim: 该试验主要终点为心绞痛症状改善率与主要不良心血管事件。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: The primary outcomes are the symptom improvement rate of angina from baseline to 4 weeks after inclusion and major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE).
claims.applicability: 说明最高质量试验以心绞痛症状与心血管事件为终点，不以血压变化为终点。
claims.uncertainty: 方案声明的主要终点，非已发表结果。

claims.claim: 该试验以生命体征（含血压与心率）与实验室检查评估安全性，未设血压叠加或症状性低血压终点。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: Safety assessment will be based on vital signs, laboratory examinations, and adverse events. Vital signs will include the respiratory rate, blood pressure, and heart rate.
claims.applicability: 血压仅作为安全性生命体征，非预先设定的疗效终点。
claims.uncertainty: 未将血压作为疗效终点报告，故不能据此判断含服后血压下降幅度。

claims.claim: 该 meta 分析纳入 41 项随机对照试验、6276 例冠心病患者。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The 41 studies consisted of 6276 patients with coronary heart disease.
claims.applicability: 冠心病/心绞痛人群的汇总样本量。
claims.uncertainty: 样本全部来自中国研究。

claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Pooled analysis indicated significant benefits of suxiao jiuxin pill on ECG outcomes (RR 1.32; 95% CI 1.26 to 1.38, P < 0.001).
claims.applicability: 心绞痛/冠心病人群的心电图替代终点，与血压叠加问题为间接证据。
claims.uncertainty: 所纳入研究多为低 Jadad 评分、异质性显著；心电图为替代终点。

claims.claim: 不良反应以轻度头痛、头晕、面部潮红为主，与对照组差异无统计学意义（RR 1.12，95%CI 0.50 至 2.51，P=0.785）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Fourteen studies reported the incidence of adverse reactions. The most common symptoms were mild headache, dizziness, and facial flushing. Most of these symptoms resolved spontaneously. There was no significant difference in the adverse reaction rates between the treatment and the control groups (RR 1.12, 95% CI 0.50 to 2.51, and P = 0.785)
claims.applicability: 心绞痛/冠心病人群不良反应汇总；头晕为症状而非低血压诊断。
claims.uncertainty: 未按高血压分层；头晕的因果归属与低血压关系未评定；置信区间宽。

claims.claim: 该 meta 分析报告的结局为心电图、血脂、血液流变学与不良反应。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The primary outcome of the selected studies was the improvement in ECG results, including resting ECG returning to normal or negative submaximal exercise test. The secondary outcomes included changes in lipid profile (total cholesterol, total triglyceride, low-density lipoprotein, and high-density lipoprotein) and hemorheology (high-cut whole blood viscosity, low-cut whole blood viscosity, plasma viscosity, hematocrit, and fibrinogen) as well as any adverse reactions.
claims.applicability: 说明现有 meta 分析的结局清单不含血压或症状性低血压。
claims.uncertainty: 该结局清单不含血压，但未报告不等于不存在，仅说明该汇总未回答血压问题。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸对人乳内动脉 KCl 与 U46619 预收缩的舒张率分别为 99.4±10.5% 与 99.9±5.6%。
claims.sourceTitle: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill Induces Potent Relaxation and Inhibition on Contraction in Human Artery and the Mechanism
claims.supportQuote: SJP caused full relaxation in KCl- (99.4 ± 10.5%, n = 6) and U46619- (99.9 ± 5.6%, n = 6) contracted IMA.
claims.applicability: 离体人动脉组织的舒张方向证据，支持本品的血管舒张机制；非体内血压测量。
claims.uncertainty: 离体器官浴实验，n=6，外推至体内血压受限。

claims.claim: 以血浆浓度（1 mg/mL）预处理人乳内动脉，可显著抑制 KCl 与 U46619 所致最大收缩（分别由 35.8±6.0 降至 12.6±5.6 mN，P=0.03；由 19.4±2.9 降至 5.7±2.4 mN，P=0.007）。
claims.sourceTitle: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill Induces Potent Relaxation and Inhibition on Contraction in Human Artery and the Mechanism
claims.supportQuote: Pretreatment of IMA with plasma concentrations of SJP (1 mg/mL), calculated from the plasma concentration of its major component borneol, significantly depressed the maximal contraction to KCl (from 35.8 ± 6.0 mN to 12.6 ± 5.6 mN, P = 0.03) and U46619 (from 19.4 ± 2.9 mN to 5.7 ± 2.4 mN, P = 0.007)
claims.applicability: 血浆浓度量级下对人动脉收缩的抑制，是离体层面最接近临床暴露的证据。
claims.uncertainty: 离体张力实验，非体内血压；浓度按冰片血药浓度推算。

claims.claim: 该舒张兼具内皮依赖与内皮非依赖机制。
claims.sourceTitle: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill Induces Potent Relaxation and Inhibition on Contraction in Human Artery and the Mechanism
claims.supportQuote: The vasorelaxation involves both endothelium-dependent and -independent mechanisms.
claims.applicability: 机制层面的方向性解释，支持对多种血管收缩刺激的舒张。
claims.uncertainty: 机制描述，不构成对血压或临床终点的结论。

claims.claim: 大鼠实验中，川芎嗪预处理 10 天使缬沙坦的 AUC、Cmax 与半衰期显著降低（4 mg/kg 组 AUC 由 851.64±104.26 降至 385.37±93.05 μg/L·h，Cmax 由 83.87±6.15 降至 62.64±9.09 μg/L，P<0.05）。
claims.sourceTitle: Pharmacokinetic interaction study between ligustrazine and valsartan in rats and its potential mechanism
claims.supportQuote: In the presence of 4 mg/kg ligustrazine, the AUC (0– t ) (385.37 ± 93.05 versus 851.64 ± 104.26 μg/L*h), t 1/2 (5.46 ± 0.93 versus 6.34 ± 1.25 h), and C max (62.64 ± 9.09 versus 83.87 ± 6.15 μg/L) of valsartan was significantly decreased, and the clearance rate was increased from 10.92 ± 1.521 to 25.76 ± 6.24 L/h/kg and similar changes were observed in the group with 10 mg/kg ligustrazine ( p < 0.05).
claims.applicability: ARB（缬沙坦）与川芎嗪的动物药动学相互作用，方向为降低缬沙坦暴露；与速效救心丸含服仅有间接关系。
claims.uncertainty: 大鼠、川芎嗪连续给药、剂量远高于含服；无人体验证。

claims.claim: 该研究将川芎嗪对缬沙坦代谢的促进归因于诱导 CYP3A4。
claims.sourceTitle: Pharmacokinetic interaction study between ligustrazine and valsartan in rats and its potential mechanism
claims.supportQuote: Ligustrazine promoted the metabolism of valsartan via activating CYP3A4.
claims.applicability: 机制解释，用于说明相互作用方向为降低暴露而非叠加降压。
claims.uncertainty: 大鼠肝微粒体与整体动物证据，未在人体验证。

claims.claim: 该 meta 分析纳入 30 项 RCT、3214 例糖尿病肾病患者。
claims.sourceTitle: The effects of Salvia miltiorrhiza and ligustrazine injection combined with ACEI/ARB on diabetic kidney disease: A systematic review and meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: The 30 RCTs included 3214 DKD patients in total (1631 in the experimental group and 1583 in the control group).
claims.applicability: 含川芎嗪成分的注射剂与 ACEI/ARB 联用的间接人群证据。
claims.uncertainty: 糖尿病肾病人群，非高血压合并冠心病人群。

claims.claim: 丹参川芎嗪注射液联合 ACEI/ARB 与单用 ACEI/ARB 相比不良反应无显著差异。
claims.sourceTitle: The effects of Salvia miltiorrhiza and ligustrazine injection combined with ACEI/ARB on diabetic kidney disease: A systematic review and meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: Additionally, adjuvant therapy with SML injection enhanced results in blood glucose, blood pressure, lipids, and inflammatory responses, and no significant variations in adverse events were discovered between the 2 groups.
claims.applicability: 含川芎嗪成分的注射剂与 ACEI/ARB 联用的间接安全性证据，人群、剂型、结局均间接。
claims.uncertainty: 静脉注射、糖尿病肾病人群；不良事件未按低血压单独报告。

claims.claim: 179 项 RCT、16,789 例患者的网络 meta 分析以 RoB 2 评定全部纳入试验均为 some concerns，显示口服中成药联合西药疗效优于单用西药。
claims.sourceTitle: The comparative effects of oral Chinese patent medicines combined with western medicine in stable angina: A systematic review and network meta-analysis of 179 trials
claims.supportQuote: A total of 179 randomized controlled trials with 16,789 patients were included. The selected trials were all assessed as some concerns. OCPMs combined with WM had a better treatment effect than WM alone.
claims.applicability: 稳定型心绞痛口服中成药联用西药的整体证据，不含速效救心丸联用降压药致低血压的专门终点。
claims.uncertainty: RoB 2 均为 some concerns；疗效为临床有效率等终点，非血压结局。

claims.claim: 突发且不缓解的胸部疼痛或不适，或伴出汗、恶心、头晕、气短的胸痛，应立即呼叫急救并在医院接受即时处理。
claims.supportQuote: Call 999 if: … you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away – the pain can feel like squeezing or pressure inside your chest, burning or indigestion … you have chest pain and you feel sweaty, sick, light headed or short of breath … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 院外突发胸痛的即时求助指征；急救号码在中国为 120，原理与指征一致。
claims.uncertainty: 来源为英国国家医疗服务体系公开页，非针对本品的专门证据。

claims.claim: 血浆浓度预处理使人乳内动脉对 KCl 与 U46619 的最大收缩分别降低约 65% 与 71%。
claims.assumptions: 假设收缩力（mN）与血管张力、收缩程度近似成比例，百分比降幅可近似代表舒张强度；该比例仅在离体同一血管床、同一预收缩剂下成立。
claims.sensitivity: 若改用各环绝对张力差而非百分比、或换用其他预收缩剂或血管床，数值会变动；该推导仅支持血浆浓度下显著抑制收缩的方向，不给出体内血压降幅。
claims.applicability: 离体人动脉层面的收缩抑制强度描述，不直接对应体内血压下降的毫米汞柱数值。
claims.uncertainty: 推导结果受样本量（n=6）与离体-体内差异限制。
